title: Bitcoin’s $84,000 wall gets harder to break as ETF inflows sink to $31 million
summary: US Bitcoin exchange-traded funds drew just $31 million in inflows on Sept. 28 as institutional demand weakened while BTC stalled below a major supply barrier.
